classification.difficultyReason: Students distinguish arrows representing one share, the combined total and the difference, then find a unit value and scale to the unknown amounts. The equal-cell bars explicitly scaffold the hardest difference case.

content.prompt: Match the diagram to the situation.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Seb and Flo share some money. Seb gets \$120.

answer.worked: Diagram iii: the arrow spanning Seb’s bar is labelled \$120.
Diagram i: the brace spanning both bars shows a combined total of \$120.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Seb and Flo share some money. Flo gets \$120.

answer.worked: Diagram ii: the arrow spanning Flo’s bar is labelled \$120.

children.label: d
children.prompt: Seb and Flo share some money. Flo gets \$120 more than Seb.

answer.worked: Diagram iv: the \$120 arrow spans the two extra cells in Flo’s bar.

children.label: e
children.prompt: For each diagram, find the amount represented by the question mark.

spec.description: Three equal Seb cells above five equal Flo cells; unknown arrows span each share and a right brace gives the combined total.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given total is visible; both share amounts remain question marks.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}8\text{ parts}&=\$120\\1\text{ part}&=\$120\div8=\$15\\3\text{ parts}&=3\times\$15=\$45\\5\text{ parts}&=5\times\$15=\$75\end{align*}$$
Seb gets \$45 and Flo gets \$75.

spec.description: Three equal Seb cells above five equal Flo cells; Flo’s arrow gives $120, while Seb’s arrow and the combined-total brace are unknown.
spec.answerVisibility: Only Flo’s given share is visible; Seb’s amount and the combined total remain question marks.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}5\text{ parts}&=\$120\\1\text{ part}&=\$120\div5=\$24\\3\text{ parts}&=3\times\$24=\$72\\8\text{ parts}&=8\times\$24=\$192\end{align*}$$
Seb gets \$72 and the combined total is \$192.

spec.description: Three equal Seb cells above five equal Flo cells; Seb’s arrow gives $120, while Flo’s arrow and the combined-total brace are unknown.
spec.answerVisibility: Only Seb’s given share is visible; Flo’s amount and the combined total remain question marks.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}3\text{ parts}&=\$120\\1\text{ part}&=\$120\div3=\$40\\5\text{ parts}&=5\times\$40=\$200\\8\text{ parts}&=8\times\$40=\$320\end{align*}$$
Flo gets \$200 and the combined total is \$320.

spec.description: Three equal Seb cells above five equal Flo cells; an arrow across the two additional Flo cells gives $120. Each share arrow and the combined-total brace are unknown.
spec.mathematics: Seb:Flo = 3:5; the difference of two parts is $120.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given difference is visible; both shares and the combined total remain question marks.

answer.worked:
The difference is $5-3=2$ parts.
$$\begin{align*}2\text{ parts}&=\$120\\1\text{ part}&=\$120\div2=\$60\\3\text{ parts}&=3\times\$60=\$180\\8\text{ parts}&=8\times\$60=\$480\\5\text{ parts}&=5\times\$60=\$300\end{align*}$$
Seb gets \$180, the combined total is \$480 and Flo gets \$300.
